# APPAI — Personal Procurement Assistant

> APPAI is an invitation-only personal procurement assistant. It helps members research products, compare supplier terms, and track purchases within the budgets and permissions they set.

## Overview
APPAI helps members turn a procurement need into product research, supplier comparisons, purchase reviews, and progress updates. Members choose the budget limits and level of authority for each instruction.

## How APPAI works
- Members describe what they need in plain language.
- APPAI researches products and compares supplier price, delivery, and return terms.
- Members review recommendations and choose whether to approve an action.
- Budget limits and permissions constrain each instruction.
- Members can follow progress and review decision records.

## Access
APPAI is currently invitation-only. Public registration is not available.

- Homepage: https://appia.intelliweblab.com/
